chapter: Early freelance work and New Orleans trumpeters
title: Photographs of Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly
summary: They discuss the lack of photos of early bands. Earl Foster is identified in a surviving band picture, and brass bands were photographed more than jazz bands.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks
